info.title: Streaming Country Catalogue API
info.description: The country and service catalogue from Movie of the Night's Streaming Availability API. Kept in its own learned-API namespace so it can evolve independently from show lookup.

get.summary: List supported countries and their streaming services.
get.description: Returns every supported country keyed by its lowercase ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Each country includes its currently supported streaming services in popularity order.

parameters.name: output_language
parameters.description: ISO 639-1 language code for localized names. Defaults to English.

200.description: Map of country codes to country records and supported services.

Service.description: A streaming service supported in a particular country.

id.description: Stable service id used by streaming options.

streamingOptionTypes.description: Which offer types this service supports in the country.

Country.description: A supported streaming market and the services available there.
